children: Pubmatic authorized expanding its share buyback program by $150 million.

The AI advertising software company was able to increase the amount it will spend on buybacks because of its debt-free balance sheet, which is providing flexibility to fund growth, Chief Financial Officer Steve Pantelick said Monday.
Pubmatic had used $226.6 million of cash to repurchase 16.5 million shares as of Sept. 30. At that time, it had $48.4 million available from its 2023 buyback purchase.

Under the new program, Pubmatic can buy back stock through the end of December 2028. Pubmatic has a total of about $198 million allocated for share buybacks through 2028, combining the remaining balance on its old program with the new authorization.

In addition to the buyback, Pubmatic recorded a 17% increase of revenue during the third quarter. The company swung to a profit of $5.5 million, or 11 cents a share, from a loss of $6.5 million or 14 cents a share, a year before.
